Title: Public Preview: Azure Cosmos DB Java SDK

Body.Content: We are pleased to announce the release of the Azure Cosmos DB Java SDK! The Azure Cosmos DB Java SDK allows you to easily create, read, update, and delete various Azure Cosmos DB resources and manage advanced configuration settings. For more information about the SDK, please visit our blog post, Introducing the Azure Cosmos DB Java SDK.
